# PubShip

> Independent, AGPL-3.0-only MCP software for Google Play developer workflows. Run locally with your own credentials. No project-run Google service.

PubShip is published on PyPI and installs with `uvx pubship`. 170 enabled methods are implemented from 172 pinned definitions. Voided purchases are disabled by policy; subscription archiving is unsupported by Google. No real-provider verification is inferred from implementation.

## Documentation

- [Source and setup](https://github.com/pubship/pubship): Local use with uvx pubship after package publication.
- [API catalog](https://github.com/pubship/pubship/blob/main/docs/api-methods.md): Enabled and deliberately unavailable operations.
- [Clients](https://github.com/pubship/pubship/blob/main/docs/clients.md): Claude Code, Codex and generic MCP clients.
- [Privacy](https://pubship.dev/privacy/): Static website privacy.
- [Terms](https://pubship.dev/terms/): License and trademark notices.

No Google endorsement. The project does not receive your Google credentials. Outside code contributions are not accepted; issues describing problems in words are welcome.
